_comment: cases/invest_cl_screening_1b under market cl with stream-specific rates; project costs as in invest_screening.json. cl nets the declared variable cost (gcost of the case as stand-in; fuel, VOM, green tax) with the energy revenue: the risky stream is the margin (CMg - cost) x dispatch. Fixed O&M (2 % of capex), insurance and warranty are known and go with the capital (stream 'capital' = project WACC 8 %). Sufficiency is an administered, near-contracted payment.
